title.narrative: UNICEF supported Somalia's progress in budget transparency, highlighting critical gaps in social sector spending, and fostered dialogue among stakeholders to improve public participation, oversight, and efficiency through budget analysis and briefs, expenditure reviews, and parliamentary advocacy workshops to promote inclusive, accountable governance and better resource allocation for key social sectors.
